newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Dock sets date for merger vote.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Dock sets date for merger vote.

text.p: Chicago Dock and Canal Trust said it will hold a special meeting April 18 for shareholders to vote upon a proposed merger with CityFront Center LLC.
The shareholder record date for the meeting is March 14.
Under the merger agreement, CityFront would acquire all outstanding shares of the trust for $25 a share in cash.
Chicago Dock signed a definitive merger agreement with CityFront in late December.
Chicago Dock also said it has satisfied the requirements of the merger agreement, and that it and CityFront concluded that the merger did not require a filing under the Hart-Scott-Rodino act.
Chicago Dock is a real estate investment trust.
